title: Keep the meter summary going past a missing minute

blocks.text: The billing job summarises each electricity meter's day: one reading per minute, in watt-hours, and `MeterDay.GAP` for a minute in which the meter sent nothing. Billing stores the energy used and the number of missing minutes; the support team reads the longest outage, the longest run of missing minutes.
Meters on a flaky mobile link miss minutes every day, and the support team wants to see whether an outage was still going on at midnight.

Finish the `TODO` inside the loop of `summarise(...)` in `src/main/java/practice/MeterDay.java`. When you're done, the summary is right for any day, wherever its missing minutes fall, and the job never stalls on one. About eight lines in total.

cases.says: a day with a reading for every minute sums all of them and reports no missing minutes
a missing minute is skipped without stalling the summary, counted, and adds nothing to the energy
a run of missing minutes at the end of the day counts as an outage, with no reading after it

origin.section: continue in a while Loop Jumps to the Condition, Past the Update at the Bottom

concepts: continue in a while loop goes straight back to the condition, so an update written after it is skipped and the loop can spin on one element forever.
